game_concept: A action puzzle set in The Kingdom – Harvest Fields, farm fields beyond the walls: the royal scribe must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against mischievous imps.
theme: The Kingdom – Harvest Fields: farm fields beyond the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Harvest Fields, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against mischievous imps. Each round, a new coins challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the potion value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 230 points of coins by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 230, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Inventory Slots' (Week 1 slot 8), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Harvest Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potion changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Harvest Fields.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 230 within 29 seconds.
